subject: Introductions: Procurement & Legal owners + MAP timeline for Nebula Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <procurement@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@nebulahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Introductions: Procurement & Legal owners + MAP timeline for Nebula Health

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I wanted to introduce the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and get procurement/legal owners aligned so we can lock a realistic close timeline. I’ve looped in Marissa (Redwood deal lead) and Jonas (Solutions/PS) on this thread.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_MAP_Nebula_v0.3.docx (draft MAP with milestones)
- Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (standard SOW template)
- redline_guidelines.pdf (preferred redline process + timeline)

High level MAP (suggested):
- T0 (today): Introductions, confirm owners & channel for redlines
- T0 + 3 business days: Redwood to provide clean SOW + SOC2 evidence
- T0 + 7 business days: Nebula to provide initial redlines and procurement checklist
- T0 + 10-14 business days: Legal & procurement alignment / final negotiation window
- T0 + 21 business days: PO or signed SOW (target close)

Questions for you:
1) Who is the primary procurement contact for contract terms vs PO issuance?
2) Who will own legal redlines (name + email) and do you prefer inline redlines on the SOW or consolidated markups?
3) Any internal gating items (security checklist owners, specific signature authorities, or procurement window constraints)?

Proposed next step: 30-minute MAP kickoff call next week to walk the milestones and agree on concrete dates. I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 2–4 PT — what works best for your team?

We’ll keep the timeline flexible, but having a named terms owner and a documented redline channel will make the review window predictable.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Ellen Park <procurement@nebulahealth.com>

Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introductions: Procurement & Legal owners + MAP timeline for Nebula Health

Hi Sofia / team —

Appreciate the clear outline. Quick answers from procurement/legal side:
- Primary procurement contact for terms & PO is me (Ellen Park) — procurement@nebulahealth.com.
- Legal will be owned by Sarah Long (General Counsel) — I’ve copied Sarah here. She prefers to receive a clean SOW and then provide a consolidated redline (PDF or Word track changes) rather than inline emails.
- For Nebula the typical gating items are: SOC 2 Type II report, data processing addendum (DPA), and an approved vendor security questionnaire — if you can surface those in the next 3 business days that helps accelerate the review.

Internal timeline (rough):
- Legal intake & initial review: 5–7 business days after receiving clean SOW + security evidence
- Procurement review & PO processing: 3–5 business days after final terms agreed
- If there are material redlines on liability/indemnity we may need one additional week for executive sign-off

I’m attaching our risk register for context (stub): Nebula_Risk_Register.xlsx

For the kickoff call, Tue/Wed next week mornings PT work best for us — Tue 10:30 PT proposed.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Nebula Health

Responses and updated plan based on your timing:
- We’ll send a clean SOW + SOC2 evidence and DPA by EOD Monday (Apr 5).
- We’re fine with Sarah providing a consolidated redline on the Word doc. We’ll leave a 10 business day window for initial redlines to give you time for intake (per your 5–7 day guidance).

Revised MAP (dates are illustrative — we’ll lock them on the kickoff call):
- Apr 5: Redwood provides clean SOW, SOC2 attestation, and DPA
- Apr 8–12: Nebula initial legal intake & redline window
- Apr 15–16: Follow-up negotiation / exec review if required
- Apr 19: Target for PO or signed SOW

Owner assignments (proposed):
- Redwood terms owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- Redwood technical/PS owner: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.com)
- Nebula terms owner: Sarah Long (sarah.long@nebulahealth.com)
- Nebula procurement owner: Ellen Park (procurement@nebulahealth.com)

Can we confirm the preferred channel for redlines? We can accept: 1) Word tracked changes in the SOW stored in Drive, or 2) a consolidated PDF with comment bullets — whichever is easiest for your legal team.

We’re happy to do the kickoff Tue 10:30 PT — I’ve tentatively blocked 30 minutes on our side. If that works for you Ellen/Sarah, I’ll send an invite and the Drive link to the draft MAP.

Thanks — I’ll share the SOW & SOC2 by Monday.

Best,
Sofia
